paragraphs: ing are constantly changing. It’s one giant game of rock, paper, scissors. You can throw rock every hand for months and crush the game if everyone is throwing scissors. But time and time again, your opponents will adapt and start throwing paper. Without a solid understanding of GTO play, you will fail to adapt and go broke.

The good news is that you have this book on your shelf. It’s like an insurance policy when times are tough. Never be afraid to take a step back and reevaluate. Poker is war, free enterprise, survival of the fittest, adapt or die, kill or be killed. It’s beautiful. Embrace it. Run good, have fun, and constantly look for ways to improve!
